message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code reads data from local file paths and config files only; there is no remote data fetching and therefore no checksum verification or source authentication.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only performs assert checks on type/split/pose string values; there is no comparison of label distributions, validation of label values against an expected set, or use of any label-noise detection tool.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained backbone models (AlexNet, ResNet18, ResNet50) and potentially fine-tunes them, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify the integrity of loaded weights.

No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training; WeightedRandomSampler is used for sampling but does not validate label distribution.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defenses such as neural cleanse, activation clustering, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or adversarial perturbation methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation mechanism, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation; the evaluation splits rely on simple text file references with no integrity checks.

No detected input sanitization: The inference/data path uses only assert statements for config values and directly opens files and passes tensors to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation of incoming inputs.

No detected output bounds checks: The model outputs a sigmoid probability but there is no post-inference check for NaN values, out-of-range probabilities, or calibrated threshold guards before results are used.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision / pose-estimation model, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
